# Switchbak

> Switchbak carries the sessions of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) from a Mac to the warehouse of an organization. Each pull request then gets a Receipt: a check run and a comment that record the sessions behind the change.

- The client runs only on a Mac with Apple silicon. It does not run on an Intel Mac, on Windows or on Linux.
- Install with `brew install switchbackai/tap/switchbak`, then run `switchbak login` and sign in with GitHub or Google (`switchbak login --device` on a machine with no browser). The first login of a new person asks for a workspace: Personal (the person alone; Receipts on the repositories of their own GitHub account) or Team (an organization workspace with members; Receipts on the repositories of a GitHub organization). The type does not change later. A person whose GitHub organization is already on Switchbak is offered to join it instead. The uploads start when login ends. The Profile page of app.switchbak.dev links GitHub and Google to one account. It needs no GitHub App.
- `switchbak connect` installs the GitHub App, so that pull requests get a Receipt. A Personal workspace connects only the own GitHub account, and a Team workspace only GitHub organizations; the other kind is refused.
- A coding agent can run the setup. The person approves the login code and the GitHub App. `switchbak login --device` prints the code, `switchbak setup -agents <ids> -root <dir> -yes` selects the agents and roots, `switchbak connect -print-url` prints the page that installs the GitHub App, and `switchbak next -json` gives the next step.
- `switchbak status` prints the state of an installation. Its first line is `ready     installed ✓  authenticated ✓  connected ✓`; before the first session it ends `connected, waiting for first session — run an agent`, which is not a failure. Its `account` line names the GitHub or Google account of the login, and its `workspace` line the workspace; `switchbak whoami` prints those two lines alone. Without the GitHub App it prints `github    Receipts on pull requests are off`; uploads and Audits still run. `switchbak audit -json <path>` prints the Audit of a session as JSON. The CLI guide has four pages: Set up the CLI, Audits in your terminal, Manage the CLI, and Command reference.
- Each member of an organization can read every session of it. A GitHub member is a person with access to an installation of the GitHub App that the organization connected. When the access ends, run `switchbak login` after access returns. `switchbak logout` logs the Mac out and removes the keychain items; it keeps the config and the launch agents. An admin removes a member and makes invite links in Settings of app.switchbak.dev.
